assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls (FAR, height, density, green ratio, setbacks) must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided provisional boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: Site boundary and key area polygons are provisional (maintainer-defined rough bounds). Official boundaries will require recalculation of all area-based metrics.
assumptions.impact: Area-based metrics are provisional and must be recalculated when official polygons become available.

assumptions.statement: All data sources are from public channels or cleared materials as recorded in sources.json and data/source_registry.json.
assumptions.impact: No non-public or unauthorized data was used.
